references.text: The same blessing on the fruit of the womb, the livestock, and the produce of the ground is mentioned as part of the covenant blessings
Identical language about abundance in the fruit of the womb, the livestock, and the produce of the land that the Lord will give
The context for God's blessing after repentance, where the Lord will make the people numerous
God rejoices over His people, the same motif of the Lord's joy over Israel
The Lord will rejoice in doing them good, parallel to God's delight over the people
The Lord rejoices over His people with gladness, the same theme of God's joy over Israel
The covenant with the fathers as the background for God's blessing, the reference to the fathers
The same promise of blessing on the fruit of the womb, the livestock, and the produce of the land
The Lord's delight in those who fear Him, a theme about God's joy over His people
